name: Saint Basil`s Cathedral
description: Construction of Basil Bolano Cathedral began in 1555 AD and was completed in 1560 AD. Located at the southern end of the Red Square outside the Moscow Kremlin, it is a major representative of Russian architecture in the middle and late period. In the mid-16th century, Ivan the Terrible built it to commemorate his victory over the Mongol invaders. The architectural style is unique, with a small internal space and an emphasis on appearance. It is more like a monument. The central main tower is a tent roof, 47 meters high, and is surrounded by 8 onion-shaped domes with different shapes, colors and decorations. The building is made of red bricks and decorated with white stone components. The large and small domes are staggered in height and brightly colored. It looks like a fire and has a strong festive atmosphere. The architects were A. Balma and Bosnik.
